dct_description_sm: COAT is a system for long-term adaptive ecosystem monitoring based on food-web theory, and aims to become the world's most comprehensive and management relevant long-term research enterprise for arctic terrestrial ecosystems. It intends to monitor the plant based food web in low arctic tundra (including the tundra-birch forest ecotone) with respect to impacts of climate change. Some data sets runs back to 2001. But the full monitoring system, following the principles of adaptive monitoring, is due to be established in 2012.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Environment surveillance
dct_title_s: Climate Ecological Observatory (COAT) for Arctic Tundra, Norway
